title: GTA 6 Pre-Orders Exceed Expectations, GTA 5 Hits 235M Sales
description: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick confirms GTA 6 pre-orders are running far beyond expectations ahead of its November 19 launch, while GTA 5 reaches 235 million sales.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## GTA 6 Pre-Orders Surpass Take-Two Expectations

As the release date for *Grand Theft Auto VI* rapidly approaches, excitement across the gaming community has reached a fever pitch. According to a recent report by Push Square following the publication of Take-Two's financial reports, the upcoming blockbuster is already shaping up to be a historic commercial success.

Speaking on the financial results, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick shared an encouraging update regarding the game's commercial momentum, stating that *GTA 6* pre-orders are "running far in excess of our expectations."

Players have had the opportunity to secure their copies since pre-orders officially opened on June 25, 2025. With the game launching on November 19, this has provided a lengthy window of nearly five months for fans to lock in their purchases ahead of time. While exact pre-order sales figures will only become fully clear following the game's release next week, industry projections and executive comments strongly suggest we are looking at the biggest entertainment release of all time.

## GTA 5 Continues Its Unstoppable Sales Streak

While all eyes are pointed toward the future and the arrival of *GTA 6*, its predecessor refuses to slow down. The latest financial data confirms that *GTA 5* has now reached a monumental 235 million sales worldwide.

The fact that *GTA 5* continues to move millions of units years after its initial launch highlights an unprecedented level of long-term market presence and ongoing consumer demand across multiple hardware generations.

## Editor's Take

With *GTA 5* sitting comfortably at 235 million sales and *GTA 6* pre-orders shattering internal projections ahead of its November 19 release, Take-Two is sitting on top of the gaming world. All signs point to an earth-shattering launch next week that could redefine industry standards for entertainment revenue.
